description: Both spouses self-employed on a joint return, no W-2s: each files their own Schedule SE. First spouse $100,000 profit: net earnings $92,350, OASDI $11,451 + Medicare $2,678 = $14,129. Second spouse $60,000: net earnings $55,410, OASDI $6,871 + Medicare $1,607 = $8,478. Schedule 2 line 4 = $22,607.
